description: When the key and value variables have the same name, the name refers to the value
notes: The spec doesn't say whether the key and value variables may share a name. hashicorp/hcl accepts it (finishParsingForExpr in hclsyntax/parser.go doesn't compare the names), and ForExpr.Value in hclsyntax/expression.go defines the key variable and then the value variable under the same name, so the value wins.
